candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment betLimit = amount, so betLimit is never updated.
Replace the assignment with betLimit = msg.value-style constant, here setting betLimit to a fixed value instead of amount.
Delete the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can change betLimit via AdjustBetAmounts (observable through currentBetLimit/AdjustBetAmounts behavior).
Set difficulty to amount + 1 instead of amount.
Remove the assignment so difficulty is never updated by AdjustDifficulty.
Remove the owner check so anyone can call AdjustDifficulty and change difficulty.
Invert the owner check so only non-owners can call AdjustDifficulty and change difficulty.
Remove the statement `openToPublic = true;` so the contract never opens to the public.
Change `openToPublic = true;` to `openToPublic = false;` so calling the function keeps the contract closed.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners can call, meaning the owner's call to OpenToThePublic reverts and openToPublic stays false.
